signatures.description: Implement Reed-Solomon decoding over GF(2^8) and GF(2^16) that corrects errors and erasures jointly via a Berlekamp-Welch linear-system formulation (Gaussian elimination with pivoting over the field), including the erasure-only fast path and the degenerate case of too many errors, which must return an explicit decoder failure rather than a silent miscorrection. Add an independent verifier that re-encodes the recovered message and proves the corrected codeword agrees with the received word in at least n - t - e positions, and fuzz across randomized error/erasure patterns for several (n, k) codes. Acceptance: zero undetected miscorrections over 10^6 randomized patterns, correct decoding up to the Singleton bound t + e <= n - k, and clean failure beyond it.
